about: The ground drill (docs/sandbox/TERRAIN-DIGGING.md, 'Sculpting'): what digging gives and what a fill costs. A scoop and a fill are balls of 'scoopRadius' metres at the crosshair, 'reach' metres at most from the eye, one every 'repeatSeconds' while the button is held. 'units' is the units of a carried material per cubic metre, both ways, so digging out and filling in balance. 'ground' is what each terrain material gives when dug; under 'stoneDepth' metres below the surface as built everything is stone. A fill reaches at most 'maxAboveSurface' metres over the surface as built. The tool stops at 'logShare' of the terrain log, so blasts always have room.
